notes: Lead profile: small SaaS support tooling co; building chat-based help widget for SMBs.
Primary ask: hosted API, quick self-serve onboarding, predictable behavior under traffic spikes (promo-driven bursts).
Traffic pattern: steady 2-5 qps baseline, occasional marketing blasts drive short 30-60s spikes to 40-60 qps (several hundred concurrent users).
Observed problem in sandbox: 429s returned during spike windows; team confused by difference between per-key quota and transient concurrency limits.
Customer quote (product lead): "If we get 429s in front of customers during a campaign, conversion drops — need graceful degradation and quick burst protection."
Requirements summary:
- Need clarity on rate-limit semantics: per-minute token quotas vs soft concurrency throttles vs hard per-second caps.
- Prefer soft throttling with Retry-After header and clear SDK retry/backoff guidance (exponential + jitter).
- Want burst buffer / credit system for occasional spikes (30s-2m) without moving to Dedicated yet.
- Cost sensitivity: ARR low; wants predictable per-token billing and low friction to stay on hosted plan.
- Security: SOC2 proves fine, SSO/SAML for team access, audit logs for production keys are mandatory.
POC asks from SE: sample concurrency settings, recommended default quotas for SMBs, example backoff policy, and fallback to smaller model on overload.
Suggested Redwood features they asked about: automatic fallback routing to lower-cost model, rate-limit dashboards per API key, per-route quotas, webhook alerts on 5xx/429 spikes.
Internal notes (AE): prioritize clear doc snippets showing headers (X-RateLimit-Remaining, Retry-After), code samples for SDK retries, and a simple pricing sketch for burst credits.
Short-term ask: one-week POC window; capture sample traffic, reproduce spike, show config that eliminates user-visible 429s for 95% of spikes.
Long-term potential: convert to paid hosted plan; later scope Dedicated if sustained high throughput emerges.
Open questions to close:
- acceptable max wait-time for user-facing requests before degrading to canned response?
- billing model for burst credits (prepaid vs auto-topup vs rate-limited free buffer)?
- any regulatory residency needs (none indicated; US only).
